fusions.name: Gore from Hiding
fusions.desc: Drives a concealed blade in with a head-down rush, dealing 40 damage and leaving the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds. The hit always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Short Lunge
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 4 tiles away and deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that from the full 4 tiles. The target is left [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Whetted Points
fusions.desc: Increases your critical damage by 30% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Sleeve Edge
fusions.desc: When you kill something, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 8 seconds. You have 5% more dodge chance.
